title: Capturing the mouse while handling mouse event stops propagation
body:
### Tested versions

At least reproducible in 4.5 through 4.8.2

### System information

Windows 10 & Debian 13

### Issue description

#### Issue
If you're setting the [Input::mouse_mode](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_input.html#class-input-property-mouse-mode) to [MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_input.html#enum-input-mousemode) while handling a mouse event, the mouse event will stop propagating to the next event handlers.

#### Expected behavior

I think the current event propagation should be independent of the mouse_mode, i.e, that the current event finishes its propagation.
The current behavior might be an okay semantic too, as long as there is also a way to choose whether the event finishes its propagation or not.

####  Imperfect (hackish) solution

I initially thought that the following was enough, but it only works some of the time.
```
Input.set_deferred(&"mouse_mode", Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED) 
```

#### Extra context

For more context initial *documentation* [issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/issues/11742).
Discussed in this engine [PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123336#issuecomment-5622518020) to document the behavior.
@AThousandShips considers this to be a bug (please correct me if I misunderstood).


### Steps to reproduce

It's a bit complicated to write up, please use the MRE.
- Open the MRE;
- launch the scene;
- click on the cube.

More details on the MRE repository.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Minimal reproducible example](https://github.com/hogoww/MRE_Godot_Mouse_capture_handler/)
